steps.title: Create the seed box
steps.body: Draw a rectangle on the ground plane and use Push/Pull to turn it into a compact box near the origin.
steps.notes: You can reuse the Draw a Box tutorial first if you want a slower introduction.

actions.description: Extrude the face into a solid.

steps.title: Select the box deliberately
steps.body: Return to Select and make sure the intended box is the active selection before modifying it.
steps.notes: If selection feels ambiguous, orbit slightly and click the top or a side face again.

success.prompt: The box is selected and ready for editing.

steps.title: Move the selection
steps.body: Activate Move, pick a reference point on the box, then place it at a nearby destination.

success.prompt: The box has been translated once.

steps.title: Move a copy
steps.body: Stay in Move, hold `Ctrl` to toggle copy mode, and place a duplicate beside the original.
steps.notes: Copy mode is tool-driven, not a separate command. The original should remain in place.

actions.description: Use Move again with copy mode enabled by `Ctrl`.

success.prompt: There are now two boxes instead of one.

steps.title: Rotate one selection
steps.body: Activate Rotate, pick the pivot, and turn the selected box to a clearly different angle.

success.prompt: One selected box has changed orientation.

steps.title: Rotate a copy from the same tool
steps.body: Use Rotate again with `Ctrl` copy mode to duplicate and rotate from the same pivot logic.
steps.notes: This is the fastest way to understand that Rotate already supports copied transforms without switching to a different tool.

actions.description: Use Rotate again and toggle copy mode with `Ctrl`.

success.prompt: A rotated copy exists in addition to the earlier boxes.

steps.title: Select the side you want to stretch
steps.body: Return to Select and pick the side by selecting its boundary segments or the face-adjacent edge set you want to drag.
steps.notes: The point of this step is to isolate only the part of the box that should move during Stretch.

actions.description: Prepare a partial selection for Stretch.

success.prompt: A side-defining subset of the box is selected.

steps.title: Stretch one side
steps.body: Activate Stretch and pull the selected side outward so the box becomes asymmetrical.

success.prompt: Only the chosen side moves while the rest of the shape stays coherent.
